title: [Bug Fix] Fix recurring journal background posting for IRS 1099 invoice lines (US)
summary: IRS 1099 subscriber no longer persists journal lines directly, preventing errors when background posting re-validates scheduled lines and allowing the line owner to control persistence.
key_points: Removed SaveChangesInGenJnlLine calls from IRS 1099 subscribers to prevent double-persistence during OnModify re-entry
Subscribers still derive IRS fields onto records but leave persistence to the owning caller
OnModify guard remains to protect user edits while allowing background posting to succeed
Added three test cases to verify scheduled posting syncs IRS data without errors and direct modify guards still work
No schema, permission, or upgrade impacts
quote: subscriber only derives the IRS fields onto the record and lets the owning caller persist
